name: Secrets Wrapper Pattern
description: Codifies the never-read-secrets-directly pattern — agents invoke wrapper scripts that source credentials at call time without exposing the values.

enforcePattern.label: Enforce Pattern
enforcePattern.description: Master switch for the secrets-wrapper pattern. On (default) blocks agents from reading secret-shaped env vars or files directly. Off makes the rule informational only - rarely correct.

secretEnvPatterns.label: Secret Env Patterns
secretEnvPatterns.description: Glob patterns (case-insensitive) for env var names agents must never read or echo. Add or remove patterns to fit your team's naming and avoid false positives.

secretFilePaths.label: Secret File Paths
secretFilePaths.description: File path patterns agents must never read directly (wrapper scripts may). Env vars in entries (e.g. ${GHOLA_BRIDGE_FILE}) expand at runtime.

approvedWrappers.label: Approved Wrappers
approvedWrappers.description: Wrapper scripts agents may invoke for secret-protected resources; each sources its secret at call time without exposing it. Only list wrappers that actually exist on disk.

${GHOLA_ROOT}/scripts/bb-bridge.mjs.value: Bitbucket/Jira bridge client - resolves the bridge bearer token from GHOLA_BRIDGE_FILE or GHOLA_BRIDGE_TOKEN at call time and never prints it

onViolation.label: On Violation
onViolation.description: How agents respond to a would-be secret read. refuse (default): blocks it. log-only: allows with a warning. ask: prompts the user.
